## Parties

This Mutual Confidentiality Agreement is entered into by and between Copperline Audio Inc (the "First Party") and Birchline Freight Inc (the "Second Party"), each referred to individually as a "Party" and together as the "Parties". This Agreement takes effect on 26 November 2026 (the "Effective Date") and is entered into in connection with a proposed acquisition of a product line (the "Purpose"). Each Party may act as a disclosing party and as a receiving party under this Agreement.

## Confidential Information

"Confidential Information" means any information disclosed by or on behalf of one Party (the "Disclosing Party") to the other Party (the "Receiving Party"), whether before or after the Effective Date, in writing, orally, electronically, visually or by any other means, that is designated as confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure. Confidential Information includes, without limitation, product and technical data, designs, specifications, know-how, business plans, forecasts, pricing, financial information, customer and supplier details, personnel information, and the existence and contents of this Agreement and of the discussions between the Parties concerning the Purpose. Confidential Information does not include information that: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; (b) was lawfully in the Receiving Party's possession, free of any obligation of confidence, before disclosure by the Disclosing Party; (c) is lawfully received from a third party free of any obligation of confidence; or (d) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of or reference to the Confidential Information.

## Obligations

Each Receiving Party shall hold the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall use it solely for the Purpose. The Receiving Party shall not disclose Confidential Information to any third party without the Disclosing Party's prior written consent, except to its directors, officers, employees, affiliates and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those set out here; the Receiving Party remains responsible for any breach by such persons. The Receiving Party shall apply at least the same degree of care it applies to its own confidential information of like importance, and in no event less than a reasonable degree of care. The Receiving Party shall promptly notify the Disclosing Party of any unauthorised use or disclosure of which it becomes aware. Where disclosure is required by law, regulation or court order, the Receiving Party may disclose only the portion required, giving the Disclosing Party prompt written notice where lawfully permitted. Upon written request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy the Confidential Information in its possession.

## Term

This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for a term of 15 months.

## Governing Law

This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or in connection with it are governed by and construed in accordance with the law of Singapore.
